inferences: The rodata file marker db/wal_manager.cc plus the two archive log strings place this function in a WAL-manager archive flow; the component reading is 'WAL replay orchestrator' (replay, then archive bookkeeping over the record vectors)

The +0x18 and +0x10 slot comparisons against relocated known functions are compiler devirtualization: when the slot equals the known implementation, the binary uses the field directly / the parse path instead of calling through the slot
The grow helper moves the element and zeroes the slot (see phase 10 grow_contract_inference)

phases.name: out init
phases.rule: out code, flags and message pointer are zeroed WITHOUT freeing a pre-existing message; precondition: the caller passes an empty out

phases.name: first replay
phases.then: replay status moved into out (old message freed); stack status cleared

phases.name: early return gate
phases.rule: if out code low byte != 0, jump straight to the epilogue (phase 11); the handler never runs, so no detail pointer exists to free

phases.name: pending drain
phases.rule: walk pending begin..end; each non-null element gets its +0x8 virtual call; nulls skipped; then pending end is reset to begin (array retained, capacity kept)

phases.name: getter
phases.note: getter output is a string (cleanup disposes it via _M_dispose); contents not read by this function

phases.head: [ctx+0xa0]
phases.invocation: handler(result_struct at rsp+0x30, getter_string at rsp+0x70)
phases.link_shape: link +0x00 = object pointer, link +0x48 = next link
phases.name: handler chain resolution
phases.rule: ten comparisons: link 1 hook vs runtime value at 0x5778258 (relocated to 0x50a97b0); links 2..10 hook vs previous link hook; the first hook that differs is invoked; if all ten match, link 11 hook is invoked

phases.name: predicate dispatch
phases.rule: result code 1 proceeds to phase 8; code 0 triggers the second replay (below) and proceeds only if the new out code low byte is 0; any other code, or a nonzero out byte after the second replay, goes to the abort path (free detail, epilogue, return)

second_replay.then: replay status moved into out (old message freed); stack status cleared

phases.name: threshold and latest-archived log
phases.rule: if pending is empty, threshold is 0 and no level-1 log is emitted; otherwise threshold = last pending element value, where the value is element +0x08 when its +0x18 slot equals the known hook 0x5208e00, else the result of calling that slot with the element (the known hook body is exactly: return arg +0x08)

phases.bounds: stack_records begin/end as loaded after the reserve; slots are visited in order and zeroed when their element moves
phases.compare: unsigned value >= threshold goes to the process arm; value < threshold goes to the move arm
phases.element_shape: element +0x08 = numeric value, element +0x10 = u32 variant selector, element +0x10 slot = virtual, element +0x18 slot = virtual

move_arm.grow_contract_inference: the binary advances past the slot without touching it again after the grow call, and the epilogue destroys only non-null stack slots; the only consistent reading is that the grow helper moves the element into pending and zeroes the slot, matching the inline path
move_arm.rule: if pending end == capacity, call grow helper 0x520a990 with (pending, slot address); otherwise append the element to pending, zero the stack slot, advance pending end by 8

phases.name: partition stack records
phases.precondition: stack record slots are non-null; the binary dereferences each slot without a null check (unlike the drain loop, which does check)

process_arm.rule: when the +0x10 slot equals the known hook 0x5209bd0, call parse 0x529ca20 if element +0x10 != 0 else parse 0x529d060, with (out=parse-out string, in=empty parse-in string, arg=element +0x08); otherwise call the +0x10 slot with (out=parse-out string, element). Then dispose the parse-in string (heap-only), emit the level-2 log, dispose the parse-out string (heap-only)

phases.value_rule: value = element +0x08 when its +0x18 slot equals the known hook 0x5208e00, else the result of calling that slot with the element

phases.name: teardown and epilogue
phases.rule: free the result detail pointer at rsp+0x38 if non-null; then walk the stack records vector begin..end calling +0x8 on each non-null element (nulls skipped); free the stack array with sized delete (size = capacity address minus begin); canary check; return out

stack_layout.getter_string: rsp+0x70: string filled by getter 0x529cde0, passed to the chain handler
stack_layout.parse_in_string: rsp+0xb0: empty inline string, inline buffer at rsp+0xc0, passed to the parse calls, then heap-disposed
stack_layout.parse_out_string: rsp+0x90: string, inline buffer at rsp+0xa0, written by the parse calls or the +0x10 virtual, logged, then heap-disposed
stack_layout.replay_status: rsp+0x40: status struct written by each caller-loop call, then moved into out
stack_layout.result_struct: rsp+0x30: code byte at +0x30, owning detail char pointer at +0x38 (freed on every path that ran the handler)
stack_layout.stack_records: rsp+0x50: vector of element pointers (begin +0x50, end +0x58, capacity +0x60), passed as out-records to the first replay call, destroyed in the epilogue

status_layout.flags_u16: +0x04, moved verbatim, never tested by this function
status_layout.gate: only the low byte of the u32 code is tested (byte 0); a code such as 0x100 passes the gate
status_layout.message_ptr: +0x08, owning raw char pointer: moved (source cleared), old value freed with plain delete[]
